R2 & Data robustness & Genuine extreme moves on the clean feed: market crash (2026-07-17 10:15) and XVAR3 -9\% earnings shock (2026-08-21 13:15) $\rightarrow$ The shock enters the risk estimate in the bar in which it happens & H,H & Lowest ratio between the VaR 99\% issued at the shock bar and the same engine without protection: $\geq$ 0.95 ratio \\ \hline
R3 & Data robustness & Moderate doses of every recoverable fault together: 1\% missing rows, duplicated, out-of-order and late rows, halted stocks, frozen quotes, bad ticks, corrupt values and sessions cut short (data/tools/inject\_faults.py, scenario everything); each fault alone is also measured $\rightarrow$ Forecasts stay close to those produced from the clean data & H,H & Share of forecasts whose main-model VaR 99\% deviates more than 5\% from the clean-data forecast, worst of the two datasets: $\leq$ 10 \% \\ \hline

P4 & Performance & The engine holds the state needed for the next forecast $\rightarrow$ The state stays small and bounded & M,L & Bytes of persistent model state per instrument (reported; no threshold set yet): reported \\ \hline
